t4BrightnessTargets.cooler_than_rock: caveAirB < knownSolidB (mean Lab b*, blue–yellow axis)
t4BrightnessTargets.solid_minus_cave_air: ≥18 luma; all known solid, per the existing audit measure

t4BrightnessMethod: Existing art-sheets.measure regions, unchanged: sampled known-air interiors are the cave-air proxy, including dug air and any rendered content in those pixels. These are lit fixture measurements, not isolated strip/source measurements. Known-solid minus cave-air uses all known solid, as the existing prototype/audit row does. Each region requires more than 500 pixels. For colour, per-pixel Lab b* is repeated into three scalar channels and passed through the unchanged region_stats masks with the same scoring keep window; pixel counts must match the original luma regions. caveAirB < knownSolidB measures cooler on the blue–yellow axis, using the existing one-decimal region-mean precision.
